items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Do you recognize the name Bob Frank? Bob?

ctx.x: Oh, I know who you're talking about. Dixie Park, that one. Dixie Park, oh yeah? And a hall of it, huh? Used to have all that. We've got advertisements from there, you know, the posters.
Do you remember any bands right there? No, no, no, no, no, no. I knew they had all that. Do you recognize the name Bob Frank? Bob?
Bob Frank, he played with a piccolo. Remember him? Bob Frank, his brother was Al C.
